strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Existing task.start distinguishes exact replay from conflicting same-source product-continuation requests, so restarted controllers cannot silently reuse a task whose requested goal or mode no longer matches.
Rust keeps the source decision fingerprint as the replay identity and fails closed before task creation when the same decision is requested with a different goal or mode_id.
Product-continuation provenance preserves the bounded remaining_capability from the source continue_development decision on the admitted task and TaskStarted evidence.
Continuation admission still creates only a Created task; it does not route, run, schedule, or invoke provider/verifier/apply execution.
The additional provenance is a bounded ASCII capability label rather than raw product evidence, prompt, response, file content, command output, or ledger payload.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, agent_loop, context_management, and progress_visualization.
answers.new_capability: A product-continuation task admission now replays only when the existing task's provenance, goal, and mode_id match the new request; mismatched same-decision requests fail closed, and bounded remaining_capability is retained in provenance.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M53.1 keyed replay on source provenance alone, so a restarted headless controller could request a different continuation goal or mode for the same decision and receive an old task without detecting the conflict.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless continuation would remain vulnerable to silent request drift across restarts, and callers would lose the source decision's remaining_capability context on the admitted task.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M53.1 task admission, M52.2 product policy ownership, and M52.1 evidence derivation because it tightens the replay identity and provenance fidelity of an already-admitted continuation primitive.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase changes existing task.start product_continuation_source behavior and protocol validation only.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds no report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, inspection, preview, dashboard, or summary-only surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust compares goal and mode_id during product-continuation replay and rejects same-source conflicts before creating or replaying a task; it also copies bounded remaining_capability from source decision payload into product_continuation_provenance.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can safely retry exact admission while detecting stale or divergent continuation intent without inspecting raw ledger payloads.
answers.milestone_progress: This makes M53 continuation admission replay-safe enough for later explicit continuation routing phases.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M53.1.1 updates the current and archived phase manifests for a real replay-safety/product-provenance behavior change. Review must confirm guard enforcement is not weakened and this is not a wrapper-only phase.

exit_criteria: Exact task.start product-continuation replay for the same source decision, goal, and mode_id returns the same continuation task/run without duplicate TaskStarted evidence
A same-source product-continuation request with a different goal fails closed before replaying or creating a continuation task
A same-source product-continuation request with a different mode_id fails closed before replaying or creating a continuation task
Bounded remaining_capability from the source continue_development decision is preserved in ProductContinuationProvenance and accepted by VSIX protocol validation
Terminal, stale, malformed, missing-authorization, product_complete, and blocked-by-product-evidence denials remain fail-closed
The admitted task is not automatically run and does not invoke provider, verifier, apply, shell, git, network, service, or workspace mutation paths

RPC and ledger metadata remain bounded and exclude raw prompts, provider responses, final responses, file content, diffs, stdout/stderr, commands, environment, raw requests, raw ledger payloads, absolute paths, canonical paths, and secrets
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test task_start_admits_product_continuation_and_replays_without_running validates exact replay, duplicate-free TaskStarted evidence, same-decision goal/mode conflict denial, remaining_capability provenance, no automatic run, raw-field exclusion, and existing terminal/stale/authorization denials.

VSIX runtimeClient protocol test validates productContinuationSource request transport and ProductContinuationProvenance remaining_capability acceptance/rejection without moving policy into the extension.

accepted_capability: Existing task.start product-continuation admission now binds replay to source decision, requested goal, and requested mode_id, and preserves bounded remaining_capability provenance.
safety_boundary: Only exact same-source, same-goal, same-mode continuation admission replays an existing task
Same-source goal or mode drift fails closed before task creation or replay
remaining_capability is optional bounded ASCII metadata copied from source decision evidence
Continuation task is Created only and must be run explicitly by existing task.run authority
Ledger and RPC expose only bounded ids, statuses, next action, replay state, SHA-256 fingerprints, and bounded capability metadata
VSIX validates transport shape only; Rust owns product-continuation policy
non_goals: No report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, inspection, preview, dashboard, or summary-only wrapper
No product-continuation run routing, headless.continue_once, automatic planning, task run, provider call, verification, apply, shell, git, network, service, or workspace mutation
No raw Product Charter, manifest, spec, ledger, prompt, provider, file, command, output, environment, absolute path, canonical path, or secret exposure
No milestone closeout in this implementation PR
rejected_alternatives: Adding an inspection RPC was rejected because the replay conflict must be enforced by task.start admission itself.
Continuing to replay by source provenance alone was rejected because it can silently mask request drift after restart.
Automatically running the admitted task was rejected because this phase only hardens admission replay identity; execution routing belongs to a later phase.
Storing raw product evidence or ledger payloads in provenance was rejected because continuation metadata must remain bounded and replay-safe.
Broad runtime modularization was deferred so this remains a bounded vertical slice.
technical_debt: crates/brownie-runtime/src/lib.rs remains large and should be split only in a cohesive future refactor.
M53 admission remains task creation only; a later phase still needs explicit continuation execution routing.
The product completion policy schema remains intentionally minimal from M52.
next_capability_rationale: M53.2 should route explicit execution of an admitted product-continuation task through existing run-control with freshness checks rather than adding a report or inspection surface.
